brief:
Today, Thursday 1 October, is Pull B, the first full pull night of the building block. Tonight's numbers come from your last full Pull B on 15 September, not from the light sets on 23 September, which was deload week. On Monday's legs you showed why: you went straight back to 145 on leg curl and 280 on calves, the same or more than mid-September, so those mid-September numbers are your real numbers at this gym.

One lift goes up in weight: close-grip pulldown moves each set up a notch to 83, 88 and 93, for 10 each, because you did 77, 83 and 88 for 10 on every set twice in a row. If there is no 93, use the next setting above 88. Incline dumbbell curl goes to the 12.5 kg dumbbells for 10 on both sets, because your last real incline dumbbell curl was 25 lb for 10 on both sets. Everything else keeps its weight and asks for one more rep: row 120, 140, 150, 155 for 10, 10, 9, 9; straight-arm pulldown 10 kg for 11 on all three sets; shrugs with the 35 kg dumbbells for 16 on all three (35 kg is the heaviest the gym has, so reps are how this one grows); reverse curl 36 for 11, 12, 11; face pulls 27 for 14 on both sets.

No pain or soreness shows in any recent note. Please step on a scale: your last weigh-in was 207 lb on 23 August, 39 days ago, with the show 151 days out.
